{{Otheruses|Squib}}
'''''[[Squib Jedi]]''''' was a children's [[Holobook/Legends|holobook]] series,<ref name="EotJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref> which was popular before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]]. The story centered around a [[Squib/Legends|Squib]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Rumors circulated that the main character of the series was based upon an existing Squib [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] with roguish qualities.<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> Volume 3 of the series was entitled ''[[Busteromuchmacho and the Vermillion Shadow]]''.<ref name="EotJ" /> Another volume was ''[[Busteromuchmacho and the Arc to Infinity]]''. During his childhood, [[Halagad Ventor]]'' was a fan of that series.<ref name="Skyewalkers">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref>

A copy of ''Busteromuchmacho and the Vermillion Shadow'' was found in the possession of [[Squib/Legends|Squibs]] scavanging the ruins of [[Almas Academy]] after [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]].<ref name="EotJ" />
